lessons.claim: ★ The rotational diffusion of a semi-dilute rod is suppressed as Dr = beta*Dr_dilute/(n L^3)^2 with beta=1.3e3 (Bitsanis MD) (the book's example n=0.1, L=50 -> 8.32e-6 = O(1e-5), reproduced). ★★ This suppression is an excluded-volume (steric) effect and not HI, and in the slender limit HI does not modify Jeffery's rotational convection (Shaqfeh-Fredrickson 1990) -> a rare piece of physics that HI-free BD can capture honestly, and being a quantitative prediction with a single free parameter it can be registered in the hypothesis role of rule 7' (abp-rod had 0 discoveries because all 5 of its predictions were implementation_check)
